content.thank_you_for_completing_your_entreprene: Thank you for completing your Entrepreneur Onboarding Questionnaire.
content.your_information_has_been_received_succe: Your information has been received successfully and is now being reviewed by your assigned EPEW Coach and the entrepreneur preparation team.
content.your_coach_may_contact_you_within_approx: Your coach may contact you within approximately 24 to 48 hours to schedule your first entrepreneur interview.
content.additional_preparation_steps_may_be_disc: Additional preparation steps may be discussed during your first interaction depending on your business idea, preparation needs, and entrepreneur development pathway.
content.delays_in_communication_incomplete_infor: Delays in communication, incomplete information, or missed interview appointments may delay the entrepreneur preparation process.
content.we_look_forward_to_supporting_your_entre: We look forward to supporting your entrepreneur journey with EPEW.
